# 地持義記卷第四

**ID:** T2803
**Volume:** T85
**Category:** 瑜伽部類,敦煌寫本部類
**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2803

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single fragmentary fascicle (the surviving fourth *juǎn*) of an anonymous Sui-Tang exegetical commentary on the *Púsà dìchí jīng* ([KR6n0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0003), T30n1581) — Dharmakṣema's translation of the *Bodhisattvabhūmi*. Recovered from the Dūnhuáng cave-deposit and edited as Taishō No. 2803 in the Dūnhuáng-text volume (T85). No author is named in the manuscript and the work cannot be confidently associated with any known commentary tradition; on internal grounds it is sometimes ascribed to the *Dìlùn* 地論 / *Shèlùn* 攝論 milieu, possibly the school of [淨影慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E5%BD%B1%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) Suí Huìyuǎn (523–592), but the attribution is not secure.

**Abstract**

The text is one of a small group of pre-Xuánzàng exegetical fragments on the *Bodhisattvabhūmi* recovered from Dūnhuáng (alongside Huìyuǎn's *Dìchí lùn yìjì* [KR6n0013](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0013) = X39n0704 and several smaller fragments). It is important as direct evidence of the early-medieval Northern Chinese reception of the *Bodhisattvabhūmi* tradition before this material was effectively superseded by [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)'s complete translation of the *Yogācārabhūmi* ([KR6n0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0001)) in 648.

The dating bracket adopted here (600–800) reflects scholarly uncertainty: the work could be Sui (a contemporary of Huìyuǎn's *Dìchí lùn yìjì*) or it could be early Tang, predating or paralleling the introduction of Xuánzàng's superior version. The textual evidence does not permit a tighter bracket. The Dynasty tag 唐 is conventional rather than firmly attested.
